answer: Require every agent to stake a small copper-backed deposit locked for a full epoch before it can attest work. A Sybil operator must fund each fake identity separately, so spawning a thousand echo identities costs a thousand deposits, while an honest agent pays once and reuses its stake. Reputation then accrues only to identities with a long, verifiable attestation history, so a fresh oasis of sock-puppets has no standing to vouch for each other until each has done real, costly work.
